You are Fable 5.1 LOW, adversarial cross-model reviewer of the frozen C9 migration publication slice and future adoption design. Read only this packet, no tools. Separate IMPLEMENTATION blockers from DESIGN blockers and optional observations; cite concrete file/line, trigger, consequence and minimum correction. End ACCEPT or REVISE. Runtime code is intentionally a bounded offline migration-sidecar hardening, not a completed adoption/cutover workflow. Do not mistake narrow scope for claiming usable SDK reads. Earlier setup/recovery changes at the same uncommitted worktree were reviewed separately and are outside this patch.
Implementation: keep migration transformation/quarantine rules, publish explicit File location + exact physical lineage + authority role, use the exact bytes parsed before transformation and check again before publication, quote KDL safely, refuse unrelated preexisting descriptors, permit exact explicit already-published resume without rewriting descriptor. Check regression error taxonomy after pinning lineage on internal opens. These byte checks are NOT atomic compare-and-swap and inputs are required quiescent; no concurrency exclusion, live migration, crash recovery intent, or arbitrary power-loss guarantee is claimed. A post-staging refusal can leave evidence; post-rename fsync failure can leave a visible descriptor, so do not infer zero effects from an exception. Stronger durable adoption ceremony remains a design/worklist.
Current protocol gap: migration creates physical Arrival genesis plus key introductions and legacy rows; it does NOT create _decl.genesis fact whose id equals new physical lineage. Thus resolve/structural verify/sync should work but declaration-dependent SDK inspect/read/edit/write should refuse without appending. Historical _decl rows must not be silently selected as own. Verify Full without cryptographic verifier excludes signature authorship, external key trust and projection; migration report is independently signed and currently verifies exact live-head equality (before future adoption appends).
Review proposed append-forward adoption identity decisions too: explicit reviewed snapshot not stale locator fallback; physical lineage fact-ID binding; no existing/colliding own anchor; mapped author proven against captured verified key registry; selected declaration observer keys must match existing history in initial scope; separate FACT/ARRIVAL signatures; immutable planned draft/recovery evidence; source legacy rows remain prefix evidence; no automatic old identity claim. Open provenance/report-domain decisions may remain explicit worklist items, but flag any unsafe recommended operation.
Tests/logs are provided evidence, not your executions. Distinguish hook exceptions/seeded partial-state tests from actual subprocess crash claims. No real user store has been selected or touched. Assess API compatibility honestly for exported editor now requiring explicit lineage/expected bytes.
